scope: STAGE-BY-STAGE loss map assembled from RECORDED repository values only. No number is invented. The canonical calculation at the bottom carries the full input provenance chain.
evidence_class_vocabulary: EXTERNAL_PRECEDENT — published-literature value carried in the package (e.g. Jacques 2013 optical properties)
MODELLED — computed/modelled, not measured (Art. XXXVIII layer 4)
COMPUTATIONAL_RESULT_ARCHIVED — computed AND the execution artifact is restored/pinned in this repository (VERIFICATION_EVIDENCE/)
COMPUTATIONAL_RESULT — measured on the built CAD solid by the deterministic pipeline
UNKNOWN — not modeled, not measured, not bounded in any committed artifact

chain.source: R370Q dossier (real source: UNKNOWN, bounded by tissue heating limit); R310 preregistered phantom (source_power_mW: 1.0, isotropic point source at z=0)

The consultant's 100 mW/cm2 incident-case reconstruction is EXTERNAL_PRECEDENT-class reviewer arithmetic, not a shipped spec.

chain.stage: 2. Tissue transmission (5 mm homogeneous phantom path)

chain.source: EQ-1 Beer-Lambert I(d) = I0*exp(-mu_eff*d) with Jacques 2013 properties (mu_a 0.05/cm, mu_s 8.0/cm, g 0.9, n 1.4) — the package's own EXTERNAL_PRECEDENT; frozen in R310 VERIF-002 preregistration

chain.notes: The Monte-Carlo chain below supersedes the analytic estimate for the 5 mm phantom; the REAL path (skin/scalp/skull/dura decomposition) remains UNKNOWN — the phantom is homogeneous.

chain.stage: 3. Fluence at the implanted PV plane (5 mm phantom)
chain.value: 1.049054 / 1.415645 / 1.146949 (three archived model anchors); recorded verified range 1.0-1.4
chain.source: LEAD_PORTFOLIO_4/P08/VERIFICATION_EVIDENCE/R310/P-16_VERIF-002_RESULT.json (4-model disagreement map, 200k photons/model, MC-vs-MC agreement 0.11 %, converged 1.049054, CI95 ±0.128); R311/P-16_VERIF-003_RESULT.json (ACTUAL PyTissueOptics v2.0.1 DCC-Lab execution, 20k photons, 1.415645, CI95 ±0.544); R312/P-16-VERIF-004_RESULT.json (convergence ladder 50k photons, 1.146949, CI95 ±0.318, CI-overlap verdict MODEL_VERIFIED)

chain.notes: R403's T2_CONFIRMED_ASSERTED_NOT_ARCHIVED class is CORRECTED by this version: the execution artifacts exist in git history (deleted at R388, restored at R404). The preregistration hashes recorded inside the result files match the restored preregistration files byte-for-byte. All three runs are CPU-mode; MCX (GPU) was never run (documented CUDA constraint). This is SIMULATION, not tissue measurement (Art. XXXVIII).

the_reconciliation.directive: R404 item 4: the reported ~1050 µW and ~121 µW must be reconciled

the_reported_1050.source: VERIFICATION_EVIDENCE/R310/P-16_VERIF-002_RESULT.json — the field is literally named 'verified_power_output_uW_assuming_1cm2_PV_100pct_conversion'; the preregistered phantom detector is 'PV cell at z=5mm, 1 cm^2 active area'
the_reported_1050.calculation: 1.049054 mW/cm² × 1.0 cm² × 1.00 = 1049.054 µW — the fluence expressed as power on the preregistered REFERENCE detector at 100 % conversion

the_reported_121.source: R403 ENERGY_BUDGET arithmetic check; re-derived here from archived inputs
the_reported_121.calculation: 1.049054 mW/cm² × 0.384845 cm² × 0.30 = 121.0 µW — the SAME fluence applied to the SHIPPED receiver area with the GaAs-class efficiency assumption

the_reconciliation.resolution: RESOLVED: the two figures are the SAME fluence under different (area, efficiency) assumptions — 1.0 cm² × 100 % (R310's reference-detector conversion, recorded by its own field name) vs 0.3848 cm² × 30 % (shipped receiver + GaAs-class assumption). The contradiction was born at R332, which re-labeled the reference conversion as '~1050 μW power output (derived from fluence × area × efficiency, MODELLED)' WITHOUT the 1 cm²/100 % qualifiers, and propagated through the R370Q dossier exports. The 1050 figure is not reproducible as a claim about the shipped receiver and must never be quoted as system output; the conditional band for the shipped receiver is 121-163 µW under stated assumptions.

derived_discrepancies: D1 [RESOLVED at R404]: the ~1050 µW claim was the R310 reference-detector conversion (1 cm², 100 %) re-labeled without its qualifiers at R332; the ~121 µW figure is the same fluence on the shipped receiver with the GaAs-class assumption. Both derivations now shown in canonical_calculation.the_reconciliation.

D2 [OPEN — engineering decision]: the >= 500 µW device target implies ~1.67 cm² receiver area at the recorded fluence and 30 % efficiency vs 0.3848 cm² shipped — a ~4.3x area shortfall (or equivalent fluence/efficiency/target adjustment). Resolution is an owner engineering decision; the decisive-experiment falsifier explicitly treats a measured power inside the conditional band as chain-confirmation + target/area relocation, NOT mechanism falsification.

D3 [PARTIALLY RESOLVED]: the complete loss decomposition now exists in one artifact with the simulation chain archived and hash-pinned; stages 1 (real source), 4 (encapsulation), 5 (targeted-cell efficiency) and 8 (power electronics) remain UNKNOWN.
module_vs_system_guard: NO number in this budget may be quoted as 'system efficiency' or 'system power'. The only recorded system-level quantities are the archived fluence (simulation) and the 500 µW target (BUYER_DEFINED). PV cell efficiency (0.30 GaAs-class) is a component figure under NON-implanted, standard-irradiance conditions.
platform_claim_guard: The 'platform technology' framing is not supported until (a) the bench phantom-path experiment measures the real chain and (b) the D2 target/area decision is made. This budget explicitly does not make that claim.
